Signs, counters, shelves, tables and machines for guests: taverns, shops, casinos, spas, cinemas and the back room.
d:DesignatorDropdownGroupDef/HH_Group_Un: Doors, pits, counters and docks for the things nobody talks about. Shown while the Underworld module is on and the content intensity is not Cozy.
d:Hearth.GuideTopicDef/HH_Guide_BackRoom: Fights, a fence and gangs. All optional: nothing of it happens until you build it.
A gate in the fence is fine. The arena needs at least 3 by 3 tiles. The marker says what it still waits for.
Build a closed fence and put a fight pit marker inside.
Right-click the marker with a colonist, tick fighters under "Fighters…", or use "Call an opponent" when you are alone. Bouts with a guest or a colonist are fought for points, so nobody gets hurt.
Gangs meet there and pay for it. Respectable guests may stumble on it now and then.
Build a room whose only doors are back room doors.
The first gang comes about a day after your first back room, fence counter or fight pit. The Underworld page says when.
Wait for the first gang visit.
Gangs sell their loot to it and buy from its stock. It pays from its own cash box.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_TheHunt.descript: A fenced hunting ground. Rich visitors pay well to shoot what you release into it. With Dark content and a fitting ideology, or with Grim content, a prisoner can be the quarry if you allow it on the marker.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_1.des: Old project, kept for old saves. Never shown, unlocks nothing: back room doors, the fight pit, the fence's counter, the smuggler's dock and the drug lounge need no research.
d:ResearchProjectDef/HH_Underworld_Disco: Old internal key project, kept for old saves. Never shown, unlocks nothing.
d:Silverline.SL_BankDef/SL_BlackLedger.p: Only open while the Underworld is on and the content is not Cozy.
d:ThingDef/HH_BackRoomDoor.description: A plain-looking door with a good lock that only your own people and shady guests can open. Build a room whose only doors are back room doors and it becomes a back room. Gangs meet there and pay for it, and it does not count against the renown of your house.
d:ThingDef/HH_FenceCounter.description: A scarred counter where a trusted fence buys stolen goods cheap and sells them to shady buyers. Once it stands, gangs sell their loot to it and buy from its stock. It pays from its own cash box, topped up from your till, and "Take goods out" empties its shelf. The owners of the goods sometimes find out.
d:ThingDef/HH_FightPitMarker.description: Put it inside a closed fence of 9 to 700 tiles. Right-click it with a colonist to fight, or use "Fighters…" and "Call an opponent"; bouts with people are fought for points and leave a few bruises at most. A pit draws gangs and whispers to your colony.
d:ThingDef/HH_HuntingGroundMarker.descri: Marks a fenced hunting ground. Put it inside a closed fence of at least sixty and at most 1600 tiles; rich hunters then come now and then and pay to shoot the animals they bring into it. With Dark content and a fitting ideology, or with Grim content, a prisoner can be the quarry; you switch this on separately on the marker.
d:ThingDef/HH_OrganClinic.description: A cold counter for the organ trade, only with Dark or Grim content. Haul harvested organs onto it; anonymous buyers collect them at night and pay without a word. Ideologies that abhor the organ trade will hold it against you.
d:ThingDef/HH_SmugglerDock.description: A bare landing pad with a shaded lamp. Once it stands, a boat sometimes lands at night and offers a crate cheap, no questions. A letter tells you, and you buy or send it away with the buttons on the dock. Now and then somebody notices the lamp.
k:HH.Setting.core.peacefulUnderworld.Des: Dark venues work without violence. This closes the fight pit completely, bouts fought for points included, and stops questioning, hunting of people, the organ clinic and protection money. Back room, fence and drug lounge stay.
k:HH.Setting.core.researchMode.Desc: Full: the Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research trees gate their buildings and features. Off: everything is available from the start.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.demandHours: Hours to answer a protection demand
A demand you do not answer within this time counts as a refusal.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.firstDays.D: The first gang comes about this many days (half to one and a half times) after the first back room, fence counter or fight pit exists.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.intimidateC: Follows the difficulty slider. On Standard Room and easier it is never more than an offer you can refuse.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.retryHours: Hours before a failed gang visit is tried again
When a gang cannot come (no friendly faction, no way onto the map), the next try is this many hours later.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.guestPurse.D: A guest who wins a bout gets this much silver, paid out of the house take of that bout (no take, no purse).
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.maxBoutTicks: After this time the fighter with the smaller share of his point limit wins. Equal shares are a draw, and all stakes are returned.
"Call an opponent" hires a pit beast for a lone fighter. The colony pays this fee: from the till first, then silver in stock, then the bank.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.scoreLimit.D: Bouts with a guest, colonist or slave are fought for points: a fighter loses when the damage he would have taken reaches this many points times his health scale. Nobody is hurt.
Bouts of prisoners and animals end when a fighter drops below this share of health, unless they are to the death. Bouts with people end on points.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.offerHo: A boat you do not answer within this time leaves; nothing else happens.
k:HH.UI.Content.Cozy.Tip: Mild stories and consequences only. Hides the whole Underworld: back room, fight pit, fence, drug lounge and gangs.
k:HH.UI.Content.Dark.Tip: Adds to Standard: prisoners may fight to the death, be questioned harder and be hunted (with a fitting ideology), and an organ clinic and the dark menu become possible.
k:HH.UI.Content.Grim.Tip: Adds to Dark: hunting prisoners needs no fitting ideology, and organ buyers place orders with deadlines.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Underworld: A discreet back room, a fight pit and a fence. Nothing of it happens until you build it.
k:HH.UI.Page.Sub.underworld: What each part of the back room is doing, offers that wait for you, whispers and takings.

k:HH.Underworld.Fence.TookOut: {0} stacks put next to the counter.

k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Letter.How: Select {0}, or open the Underworld tab, to pay or to refuse. The colony pays from the till, silver in stock or the bank. The offer stands for {1} hours; letting it run out counts as a refusal.
k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Pay.Desc: The colony pays from the till, silver in stock or the bank. The gang leaves you alone and its faction thinks a little better of you.
k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Refuse.Desc: Refuse. The gang's faction takes it badly and loses goodwill.
k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Demand.Refused: You showed the gang the door.

k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Status.PrisonOff: Gangs may question your prisoners if you allow it in the settings.

k:HH.Underworld.Gang.Why.NoPawns: no gang members could be found

k:HH.Underworld.Hunt.Prisoners.Desc: Let hunters hunt a prisoner released into the ground. Dark content with a fitting ideology, or Grim content.

k:HH.Underworld.Hunt.Status.NotBuiltRese: Put a hunting ground marker inside a closed fence of {0} to {1} tiles.

k:HH.Underworld.Lounge.Status.NotReady: The lounge is not set up yet.

k:HH.Underworld.Organ.Status.NotBuilt: Research the black clinic and build its counter.
k:HH.Underworld.Organ.Status.Waiting: Organs left on the counter are collected at night (23:00 to 04:00).
